lens 0.1->0.0
  out: {
    if in.rootfield.branch == 1 {
      out.rootfield <- in.rootfield (alt 0 -> 0)
    }
    if in.rootfield.branch == 2 {
      out.rootfield <- in.rootfield (alt 1 -> 1)
    }
    if in.rootfield.branch == 3 {
      out.rootfield: alt 0 {
        out.rootfield.branch = 1
        out.rootfield.branchone = "wasthree"
      }
    }
  }
  lacuna LossyFieldMapping {
    when in.rootfield.branch == 3
    source rootfield = in.rootfield
    target rootfield = out.rootfield
    message "rootfield was branch 3, which 0.0 does not have; branch 1 with branchone \"wasthree\" was substituted"
  }
